# <a id="_Toc135734846"></a>Trainings

##### Purpose of this document is to describe developer onboarding training for TeamcenterX\. 

##### Scope

This document specifies the steps one should take to ramp\-up in TeamcenterX development\. The document refers only to tasks that are TeamcenterX specific and may not include information that is generally applicable for all DI SW LCS development teams\. 

- Training needed to enable newly joined developers to work in TcX development
- Special training that may be needed from time to time\.

## <a id="_Toc135734847"></a>Developer training and procedure to access them\.

### Microsoft Teams for TeamcenterX

The first step towards enabling a new employee to the TeamcenterX teams is to give him/her understanding of Microsoft Teams that are used regularly by the TeamcenterX development teams\. This enables him to locate and access the content necessary for the development teams and Teams Channels associated with it\. Individual teams may have assigned channels or their own team\. It’s the responsibility of the scrum master and/or mentor to ensure the team member has access to each team\.

## <a id="_Toc135734848"></a>Procedure for Special Trainings

When a new component or feature is introduced, it might need training for employees\. Such trainings may arise when:

- A new development or security tool is introduced\.
- The developer team needs upskilling\.

When a new tool or change in development environment is introduced the manager ensures that the relevant training either in house or by external provider is imparted to team members\.

For upskilling the team members, the team members can either browse the siemens My learning for available trainings or reach out to their managers for such trainings\.
